text:
alex: Hi all — accepted the org invite but I only see public repos under https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference and 0 in 'Your repositories'. 2FA is enabled. Anyone know why?

[devex-bot]: GitHub Invite Event: invite accepted for alex. Note: some private repos require SSO authorization.

maria: welcome! quick checklist: confirm your GH account email matches the invite, authorize SSO on the org page, and add your SSH key if you plan to use SSH. Team perms can take a few mins after onboarding automation.

jamal: run `ssh -T git@github.com` and paste output. If it says Permission denied (publickey) your key either isn't added or the agent isn't loaded.

alex: `Permission denied (publickey)` — i added my key under Settings a minute ago.

jamal: run `ssh-add -l`. If no keys, `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa` (or your key path) then retry `ssh -T`.

irene: infra repos are private + SSO enforced. even if SSH auth works you need to be in infra-team to view them. post your GH handle and i'll check.

alex: handle is alex-dev. after `ssh-add` `ssh -T` returns: "Hi alex-dev! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access." still getting 403 on the infra repo.

maria: SSH auth looks fine. jamal or irene can check team mapping — onboarding bot sometimes misses the infra-team assignment.

jamal: adding alex-dev to infra-team now. give GitHub ~5-10 mins to sync.

[devex-bot]: Onboarding automation: team sync queued for alex-dev (job id: 89231).

alex: refreshed and can clone infra repo now. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

maria: awesome — welcome aboard! ping #eng-ops if anything else blocks your first day.

jamal: i'll update the onboarding ticket to make the infra-team mapping more deterministic for new hires.
